name: Ririmu
message: 「...Hey, nice work.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ririmu-san...」
When I returned to the entrance, Ririmu-san was there.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ah... congrats! You made it to the semifinals, huh?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, thank you... ah...」
I was so completely drained that my legs gave out. Both my spirit and my stamina were at their absolute limit.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoa, Asahi... are you okay！？」
A flustered Ririmu hurried to my side to steady me.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Let's get you in a chair first, come on...」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ririmu-san... thank you.」
With Ririmu-san supporting me, I managed to sit in the chair.

name: Ririmu
message: 「You look awful, you're totally falling apart...！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「To fight Arakawa-senpai until you ended up like this...！」
Ririmu-san squeezed my hand tightly.

name: Asahi
message: 「...I heard you, Ririmu-san. Your voice.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ah... I see, so you heard that.」
She made a look that seemed somehow embarrassed.

name: Asahi
message: 「From 'You idiot Asahi' all the way to the end, I heard it all.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「That's like, everything then!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「So embarrassing... seriously, just forget about that.」

name: Asahi
message: 「No, I won't. I'll remember it for the rest of my life.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Heyyy! Quit it with the harassment already!」
I shook my head.

name: Asahi
message: 「No, I'm grateful for it.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Thanks to you calling out for me so desperately, Ririmu-san, I was able to manage and block Arakawa-senpai's pursuit.」

name: Asahi
message: 「If that hadn't happened, I'm sure I would have lost by now.」

name: Asahi
message: 「That's why... thank you, Ririmu-san.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「T-that's enough of that...！」
Ririmu-san turns to face me again.

name: Ririmu
message: 「More importantly... I'm really sorry about that thing on the final day of the preliminaries.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Asahi protected me, but I took it out on you and told you to stop doing things on your own...」

name: Asahi
message: 「No, I am the one who should apologize.」

name: Asahi
message: 「It is true that I acted on my own without considering your feelings, Ririmu-san... I am truly sorry.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「...Geez, you dummy.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You could at least just accept my apology like a normal person right now!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Otherwise, I'll be left feeling sorry toward you forever, and I... I don't know what to do...!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, sorry... I did it again, didn't I?」
I gently stroke Ririmu-san's head as she leans it toward me.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Asahi, thank you...！ You avenged me...！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「It made me so, so happy...!」
I've exhausted everything I had, and my head is spinning. But I have to tell her.

name: Asahi
message: 「...I have properly proven it.」

name: Asahi
message: 「That you have worked harder than anyone else, and that I have been right by your side watching it the whole time.」

name: Asahi
message: 「That there has never been a time you took on a haughty attitude just because you are wealthy.」

name: Asahi
message: 「And that your Jindou is most certainly not just some game...！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Asahi...！」

name: Asahi
message: 「I have properly made that upperclassman apologize for their insolence...！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Why... would you go that far for someone like me...?」

name: Asahi
message: 「...Didn't you say it yourself?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Because we are friends.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Because I want us to be friends forever.」

name: Asahi
message: 「That is why... I will never forgive anyone who tries to hurt what is precious to me...!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ugh... *sniff*... Asahi...！」
Ririmu-san hugged me tight.
For a while, she just kept crying against my chest—.

name: Asahi
message: 「Hah, hah...」
Perhaps because my exhaustion had reached its peak, my legs were trembling as I walked.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wait, are you okay？ We need to get to the medical room!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, well, that is where I am heading right now.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「No, no way, there's one inside the stadium too, isn't there！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Well, there are so many people over there...」

name: Asahi
message: 「You can go back to watching the matches, Ririmu-san.」
In truth, the biggest reason was that I didn't want Ririmu-san to see me looking so weak.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Are you an idiot? I'm coming with you to the medical room！」

name: Asahi
message: 「But then there was no point in me walking here...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Huh？ Forget it, come on！」
To my surprise, Ririmu-san had swept me up into a princess carry.

name: Asahi
message: 「Ri, Ririmu-san... this is embarrassing...！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「If you keep dawdling like that, it'll be evening by the time we get there. It's fine. I've got energy to spare.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I mean... let me do at least this much, Asahi.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「We're friends, after all.」

name: Asahi
message: 「...I suppose I have no choice.」
I was too tired to resist anymore, so I decided to let Ririmu-san carry me the rest of the way.

name: Asahi
message: 「Ririmu-san, may I ask you something？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hm, what is it？」

name: Asahi
message: 「While you were holed up, what were you doing?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Pfft—you're really asking that？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, I want to know.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well, you know, just looking at online clothing stores in my room...」

name: Asahi
message: 「Heh... what on earth is that?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Don't laugh! I was healing my wounded heart by looking at a bunch of cute clothes, okay?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Looking at clothes heals you？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I mean, yeah. You could say I'm reconstructing my crumbling worldview.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「...Maybe I'm actually more suited to being a model than a swordswoman, huh?」
It seems she's feeling disheartened after being eliminated in the qualifiers.

name: Asahi
message: 「...That's not true at all.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ririmu-san, you will become stronger, much stronger. I guarantee it.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Asahi...」

name: Asahi
message: 「If you use your phantoms more wisely and cleverly, they can become vicious traps.」

name: Asahi
message: 「We'll do thorough research beforehand, then use phantoms that pinpoint the opponent's trauma to break their spirit.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Alternatively, we could also exploit human conditioned reflexes to restrict the opponent's actions as we please.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I can think of plenty of other ways to make you stronger.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Asahi, you're seriously brutal... I'm really glad you aren't a phantom user.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Heh, I suppose so.」
I smile while being cradled in Ririmu-san's arms.

name: Ririmu
message: 「But yeah, you're right. I guess I've realized there might still be things I can do.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Thanks, Asahi!」

name: Asahi
message: 「No, please, don't worry about it.」
After all, this is just my own ego.

name: Asahi
message: （I just... I want to keep being a swordswoman with you a little longer, that's all.）

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey, Asahi... good luck in the semifinals.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I'll be cheering for you more than anyone else.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Next time, I'll properly cheer for your match, starting right from the front-row seat！」

name: Asahi
message: 「…Even if it means having to fight Momiji next？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yeah, I mean, Momitchi is a precious friend too, but」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Asahi is my best friend, after all」
Ririmu-san, smiling as she said that, felt somehow incredibly dazzling.
